steps.name: core-hardening
steps.summary: Fixed 7 review defects test-first (I-050..I-056): SessionStore.subscribe(id, onChange, onError?) and the SSE route closes on listener error (MemoryStore.failSubscribers for tests); FirestoreStore caches only a successful init (injectable loader, firestore.test.ts); setDineOption change in confirming bumps cartVersion; sessionSecrets.recentResults (last 10, server only) replays a duplicate's result, a repeated reissueClaim rotates again before paying; ACTOR_SOURCES binds source to actor (phone voice/text/button, kiosk touch, else BAD_REQUEST) in applyCommand; shared SESSION_ID regex + sessionId zod schema in commands/schemas.ts for envelope, ping, claim, SSE; IPv6 rate-limit keyed by /64. Also :lang(ko) keep-all in globals.css and devIndicators:false (I-057). ARCHITECTURE, SECURITY and docs/ko updated per R-002. Phone code must send source button only from real taps.
